layout: Eight frames, four columns by two rows; packaged at 1024x512. Pipe uses four frames in a 2x2 512x512 sheet.
style: Polished chunky pixel art, shaded bevels, generous transparent margins, no rectangular backgrounds, fixed framing across frames. Reference: milestone_mechanics_duck.png.

scenes.prompt: Midnight: shimmering pale-gold stars drift on curved paths and join into a constellation EXCLAMATION MARK. Frames progress scattered stars, gathering stars, first connections, mostly formed constellation, fully formed vertical exclamation constellation, two subtle twinkling variations, settled final. Delicate navy/purple stellar accents. Stars/connecting stardust ONLY, transparent space with no rectangular sky background.

Field Grey: polished brass military BUGLE raises a small deep-red WARNING FLAG from its bell. Frames: bugle ready, lightly vibrating, flagpole begins extending, flag halfway raised, flag fully raised, flag waves left, flag waves right, settled fully raised flag. A simple exclamation mark on flag, small floating music notes. Grey-green accents, brass bevel highlights.

Arctic Station: an elegant glass THERMOMETER with metallic blue casing, its liquid column drops from warm to deeply cold as intricate small frost crystals spread outward. Frames: high warm liquid, cooling, mid column, low blue column, frost starts, frost spreads, frosty finish, settled icy thermometer. No digits/text required. Glass/cyan/ice crystals, detailed but readable, no enclosing square.

BurgSys: sinister black-purple CLASSIFIED FOLDER opens slowly and TWO GLOWING PURPLE EYES emerge from the darkness inside. Frames: sealed folder, seal loosens, flap starts opening, narrow eyes glow, eyes fully revealed, glow swells, eyelids briefly half-close, settled fully open eyes in folder. Rich purple-black shadows and clean embossed folder edges, fictional occult gothic aesthetic, no historical insignia, no text needed.

Sons of Sorel: heavy industrial steel GEAR overheats, glows orange between teeth, then smoulders with little curling smoke and embers. Frames: cold steel gear, spinning slight turn, heating red, glowing hot, orange ember edges, smoke begins, smoke curls, settled charred grey gear with tiny embers. Crisp metal bevels, ember pixels and smoke wisps; no box or background.

Stallonian Gambit: appetising SANDWICH opens to reveal an ERROR REPORT. Frames: closed sandwich, upper bread begins lifting, filling separates, paper peeks out, report unfolds, fully raised report between bread halves, slight comic wobble, final open sandwich with readable small exclamation symbol on paper. Golden bread, lettuce/tomato/cheese layers, white paper. Do not add a character or text captions.
scenes.cleanup_prompt: Preserve all eight4x2 animation frames, colors, text and pose order. Remove detached clipped fragments from neighboring cells, especially left edge and top of last cell. Keep complete artwork self-contained within generous empty alpha0 margins; slightly shrink uniformly if necessary. No clipped tools, bread, paper, background or captions.

scenes.prompt: Halloween: a small expressive black-and-orange SPIDER stitches a warning EXCLAMATION MARK into a delicate WEB. Frames: spider on a loose silk thread, begins web, half web, begins vertical warning stitch, warning nearly complete, completed exclamation in web, spider moves to edge, final spider perched beside finished warning. Glinting silver silk, orange highlights, elegant readable web with no rectangle behind it.

Christmas: beautiful small SNOW GLOBE shakes and snow swirls, clearing to reveal a red BUG inside. Frames: settled snowy globe, tilts left with snow stirring, tilts right with swirling snow, snow vortex, bug becomes visible, snow settles down, bug fully revealed, final globe with small snowdrift around red bug. Polished glass highlights, festive red/gold wooden base, small holly detail. No words, no scene background.

Vaporwave: a striped coral-pink SUNSET over a cyan-purple WIREFRAME GRID glitches into a NEON WARNING TRIANGLE containing an exclamation. Frames: striped neon sun, mild tracking glitch, sun slices displaced, stronger cyan/magenta glitch, slices forming triangle, neon triangle replacing sun, glow settles, final warning triangle over small wireframe grid. Clean synthwave pixels, no rectangular black background, every space outside actual neon geometry transparent.

Rising Sun: delicate CHERRY BLOSSOMS drift through the air and gather into a clear EXCLAMATION MARK. Frames: blossoms on tiny branch, petals detach, petals swirl, gather in vertical stream, near exclamation shape, full blossoming exclamation, light petal shimmer, final pink blossom exclamation with a little branch below. Soft pink flowers with gold centres and warm brown twig. No sky, no enclosing circle or background.

Andorran Dream: an ornate embossed GOLD COIN spins and becomes a golden EXCLAMATION MARK medallion. Frames: full decorative coin, tilted coin, thin edge, other side turning toward viewer, warning side nearly facing viewer, full warning medallion, golden sparkle, settled round medallion with large bold exclamation. Deep gold bevels and subtle red-blue enamel accents. Real depth, legible clean pixel edges. No rectangular shadow.

Classic: a traditional RUBBER STAMP stamps NEEDS ATTENTION onto a paper error report. Frames: clean report and raised stamp, stamp descending, approaching page, contacts paper, compression/ink impact, stamp lifting and red imprint revealed, stamp almost withdrawn, final paper with red NEEDS ATTENTION stamp. Polished wooden handle and dark-red rubber pad, cream paper with a few understated report lines. Only text is NEEDS ATTENTION on the paper, no captions.

scenes.prompt: Four-frame Trotsky duck, cream feathers, white hair/goatee, round glasses and red scarf, frantically patches a leaking copper pipe. Discover leak, press wing over crack, wrap red cloth, relieved final tied patch. Same polished pixel style, transparent margins, no background;2x2 grid.
